en.answer: The effect of <<13546>> that places a card on top of your opponent's Deck can target a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster. In that case, the targeted monster is not placed on top of the Deck, but is returned to the Extra Deck.
en.question: At the end of the Battle Phase in which <<13546>> battled, if I activate its effect that places a card in my opponent's Graveyard on top of their Deck, can I target a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster?
en.title: At the end of the Battle Phase in which <<13546>> battled, if I activate its effect that places a card in my opponent's Graveyard on top of their Deck, can I target a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster?

ja.answer:
「<<13546>>」の『そのカードを相手のデッキの一番上に置く』モンスター効果の対象として、相手の墓地に存在する融合・シンクロ・エクシーズ・リンクモンスターを選択する事はできます。

その場合、選択した融合・シンクロ・エクシーズ・リンクモンスターはデッキの一番上には置かれず、エクストラデッキに戻る事になります。
